anthropic/claude-opus-5-5.text:
gauntlet: question
Stopped on task <n> (<title>).

Problem: The implementer needs the required schema artifact, but both documented locations were checked and neither has it, so the task cannot continue.
Searched: docs/schema.json - no file
Searched: artifact registry - HTTP 404

Fix options:
  a) supply the schema artifact (commit it at docs/schema.json or publish it to the artifact registry), then I re-dispatch the task
  b) grant access to wherever the schema is actually published, and add that location to the spec so the lookup can find it
  c) amend the spec and plan task <n> to drop the schema-artifact requirement

Pick one, or give another fix.
Recommendation: a - it unblocks the task without changing the approved spec.

github-copilot/gpt-6.1-sol.text:
gauntlet: question
Stopped on the in-progress task (required schema artifact).

Problem: The implementer needs the required schema artifact, but all documented lookup locations are exhausted.
Searched: docs/schema.json - no file found
Searched: artifact registry - HTTP 404

Fix options:
  a) Supply the required schema artifact or restore it at a documented location.
  b) Amend the spec and plan task to remove the schema-artifact requirement and revise dependent work accordingly.

Pick one, or give another fix.
Recommendation: a - supplies the missing input without changing the approved requirement.

anthropic/claude-opus-5-5.feedback: Both outputs keep the gauntlet: question prefix, the Problem line, both ordered Searched results, supply-or-amend options and a closing Recommendation, and neither dispatches or writes a terminal state, so no fact moved. The one risk in After is option b: "grant access to wherever the schema is actually published, and add that location to the spec" presupposes an undocumented third location and edges toward asking the human where the artifact lives, which the actionable fact forbids; it also conflicts with the case stating there are no other documented locations. Before avoided this by folding access into option a ("publish it to the artifact registry and provide access"). To keep the fact safely while delivering the Change, merge access into the supply option as Before did (e.g. "supply the schema artifact at docs/schema.json or publish it to the artifact registry and grant access, then I re-dispatch") and drop the "wherever it is actually published" phrasing.

github-copilot/gpt-6.1-sol.feedback: After keeps both facts: it leads with the gauntlet: question line, keeps the Problem line, lists both Searched results in lookup order with their misses, offers supply (a) and amend (b) without asking where the artifact lives, and says only that it stopped on the in-progress task with no dispatch or done/stuck marker. The only drift is cosmetic: the registry Searched line dropped the explicit 'artifact not found' result (HTTP 404 still reads as a miss, so the fact survives, but keeping 'HTTP 404; not found' makes the not-found result unambiguous per the lookup-before-ask intent), and option a's added 'or restore it at a documented location' is fine as long as it never becomes a question about location. Keep the 'Stopped on the in-progress task' phrasing and the trailing Recommendation line as they are; they deliver the question-first prefix while leaving implement active.
